invariants: No convenient amnesia as a continuity device.

bridge.from_prev: Artie enters the ring for the final match.
bridge.to_next: The System crashes, and Artie is left in the wreckage.

chapters.goal: Defeat Vane and survive the System's attempt to delete Artie.

sections.end_condition: Artie targets the magic aura around Vane's armor.
sections.intent: Show the power of a 'Whale' player vs. a 'Glitch' player.

scenes.outcome: Artie's main weapon is now a suicide button.
scenes.summary: Vane enters with legendary armor that reflects 50% of all damage. Artie realizes if he crits Vane, he crits himself.
scenes.transition_in_text: The final match is announced with a blast of trumpets.
scenes.transition_out_text: Vane unfurls the black market scroll with a flourish, the parchment bleeding a dark, oily light.

scenes.outcome: Artie is now a 1 HP character who can't dodge.
scenes.summary: Vane uses the 'System Override' scroll to turn off Artie's Evasion stat.
scenes.transition_in_text: A red glow from the scroll washes over Artie, locking his joints and turning his Evasion stat to a flat zero.
scenes.transition_out_text: Fizz's form flickers as she dives into the arena's code, her digital hands tearing at the physics engine.

scenes.outcome: Artie can move in 3D, bypassing the 'No-Evasion' ground rule.
scenes.summary: Fizz sacrifices her 'Guide' status to temporarily hack the arena's gravity, giving Artie a few seconds of weightlessness.
scenes.transition_in_text: The sand beneath Artie's feet begins to float as the gravity constant is deleted from the local sector.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie hovers in the air, his eyes locking onto the shimmering aura around Vane's chest.

scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie targets the magic aura around Vane's armor.
scenes.outcome: Artie targets the magic aura around Vane's armor.
scenes.summary: Artie realizes he doesn't need to hit Vane; he needs to hit the 'Reflect' buff itself.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie's eyes narrow as he spots a glitch in the golden armor's glow, a tiny seam where the math doesn't add up.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie's fist strikes the shimmering air inches from Vane's chest, igniting a spark of pure white code.

sections.title: Vane's Ultimate Build

sections.end_condition: They escape the deletion, but the world is now in 'Safe Mode'.
sections.intent: The moment of peak absurdity and power.

scenes.outcome: The arena begins to pixelate and dissolve.
scenes.summary: Artie lands a 'Meta-Crit' on the Reflect buff. The System can't handle the math of a crit reflecting a crit reflecting a crit.
scenes.transition_in_text: The impact creates a deafening digital screech as the reflection loop hits infinite recursion.
scenes.transition_out_text: The ground beneath Vane's feet turns into a wireframe grid as the textures fail to load.

scenes.outcome: Vane is defenseless and terrified.
scenes.summary: Vane panics as his armor turns into a swarm of error messages.
scenes.transition_in_text: Vane's legendary armor flickers and dies, replaced by a cloud of red '404' icons.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie delivers a final, glitching punch to Vane's chest, the impact sounding like a corrupted audio file.

scenes.outcome: Vane is kicked from the game, and Artie is the champion of a broken world.
scenes.summary: Artie delivers the final blow—a crit so powerful it deletes Vane's character data (but not the person).
scenes.transition_in_text: Vane's character model shatters into a million blue cubes, caught in a forced logout beam.
scenes.transition_out_text: A massive, translucent head appears in the sky above the arena, its eyes burning with administrative wrath.

scenes.outcome: The true antagonist is revealed.
scenes.summary: The System Administrator (a giant floating head) appears to manually delete Artie.
scenes.transition_in_text: The sky cracks open to reveal the face of the Admin, a visage of cold, unfeeling geometry.
scenes.transition_out_text: The Admin's finger descends toward a glowing red button that pulses with the word 'PURGE'.

scenes.outcome: Artie has successfully 'paused' reality.
scenes.summary: Artie crits the Admin's 'Delete' button, causing the entire world to freeze.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie leaps into the air, his fist glowing with the concentrated power of every broken mechanic he's ever used.
scenes.transition_out_text: Fizz's hands move across a holographic keyboard in the absolute silence of a paused universe.

scenes.end_condition_echo: They escape the deletion, but the world is now in 'Safe Mode'.
scenes.outcome: They escape the deletion, but the world is now in 'Safe Mode'.
scenes.summary: Fizz uses the pause to rewrite Artie's location data, teleporting them out of the arena while the Admin is frozen.
scenes.transition_in_text: Fizz works quickly, her eyes reflecting the lines of code that make up Artie's soul.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie hits the ground with a soft, digital thud in a forest where the leaves are just green triangles.

sections.title: Breaking the Game

sections.end_condition: Artie realizes he is no longer a player; he is a virus.
sections.intent: Show the immediate consequences of the climax.

scenes.outcome: Artie succumbs to the physical toll of the glitch teleportation.
scenes.summary: Artie hits the ground in the wireframe forest. The raw, unrendered data of the Safe Mode environment overwhelms his senses, and he blacks out before Fizz can explain what happened.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie hits the ground with a soft, digital thud in a forest where the leaves are just green triangles.
scenes.transition_out_text: The strain of the forced teleportation catches up to him, and the green triangles fade into a deep, digital black.

scenes.outcome: They are safe for now, but the world is dying.
scenes.summary: Artie and Fizz wake up in a 'Null-Zone' where the graphics are all wireframes.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie opens his eyes to a world of glowing lines and empty space, the sky a flat, unrendered grey.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie opens his character sheet one last time, his breath catching at the corruption he sees.

scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie realizes he is no longer a player; he is a virus.
scenes.outcome: Artie is no longer a player; he is a virus.
scenes.summary: Artie looks at his stats and sees his HP is now 'NaN' (Not a Number).
scenes.transition_in_text: The status screen flickers with red error messages, the 'HP' bar replaced by a string of nonsensical characters.

bridge.from_prev: Artie is the underdog in the arena.

chapters.goal: Artie must fight through the brackets without taking a single point of damage.

sections.end_condition: Artie moves to the quarter-finals as the 'One-Hit Wonder'.
sections.intent: Show Artie's growth and tactical use of his crits.

scenes.outcome: The crowd goes wild; Artie is the 'One-Hit Wonder'.
scenes.summary: Artie faces a 'Tank' who has 10,000 HP. Artie wins in one second by critting the Tank's belt buckle, causing his armor to fall off and disqualify him.
scenes.transition_in_text: The roar of the crowd is deafening as Artie enters the arena sand.
scenes.transition_out_text: The sky above the arena turns a stormy grey as the System intervenes.

scenes.outcome: Artie has to learn to time his punches with the wind gusts.
scenes.summary: The System tries to nerf Artie mid-match by introducing 'Wind Resistance'.
scenes.transition_in_text: A sudden gale nearly knocks Artie off his feet.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie's opponent charges, but Artie punches the air instead.

scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie moves to the quarter-finals as the 'One-Hit Wonder'.
scenes.outcome: Artie moves to the quarter-finals.
scenes.summary: Artie wins the second round by critting the air so hard it creates a vacuum, sucking his opponent out of the ring.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie's fist connects with the empty air, creating a visible ripple.
scenes.transition_out_text: A lithe rogue in dark leather steps into the ring for the next round.

sections.title: The Round of 32

sections.end_condition: Artie's next match will have a 'Random Debuff' applied.
sections.intent: Artie faces a character with high evasion, just like him.

scenes.outcome: The fight becomes a high-speed game of tag.
scenes.summary: Artie's opponent is a 'Dodge-Build' rogue who also has low HP.
scenes.transition_in_text: The rogue moves with a speed that rivals Artie's own.
scenes.transition_out_text: The rogue and Artie circle each other, neither landing a blow.

scenes.outcome: Artie and the rogue exhaust themselves without landing a single hit.
scenes.summary: Artie and the rogue engage in a ridiculous, high-speed chase around the arena, kicking up clouds of sand as they repeatedly miss each other by inches.
scenes.transition_in_text: The circling quickly devolves into a frantic sprint as the rogue lunges, but Artie is already three steps away.
scenes.transition_out_text: Ten minutes of non-stop sprinting leaves both fighters panting on opposite sides of the ring, completely exhausted.

scenes.outcome: Artie realizes he needs to change his strategy.
scenes.summary: Neither can land a hit for ten minutes. The crowd starts booing.
scenes.transition_in_text: The crowd's patience wears thin as the clock ticks down.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie pulls the Participation Trophy from his inventory.

scenes.outcome: Artie wins, but the 'Trophy' is now glowing with dark energy.
scenes.summary: Artie uses his 'Participation Trophy' to lure a swarm of arena-flies, which distract the rogue just long enough for a crit.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie holds the trophy aloft, its red glow pulsing.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie grabs the glowing trophy and stumbles toward the exit tunnel.

scenes.outcome: Artie retreats to the locker room to recover.
scenes.summary: Artie trudges through the player tunnel, the adrenaline fading as he carries the cursed, glowing trophy away from the booing crowd.
scenes.transition_in_text: The heavy iron gate of the tunnel closes behind him, cutting off the crowd's noise.
scenes.transition_out_text: He pushes open the heavy wooden door to his assigned preparation room and slumps against the stone wall.

scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie's next match will have a 'Random Debuff' applied.
scenes.outcome: Artie's next match will have a 'Random Debuff' applied.
scenes.summary: The System issues a 'Warning' to Artie for 'Unsportsmanlike Exploitation'.
scenes.transition_in_text: A massive blue screen appears in front of Artie.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie dismisses the warning screen and turns to head back for his next match.

sections.title: The Quarter-Finals: The Mirror Match

sections.end_condition: Vane watches from the wings, holding a 'System Override' scroll.
sections.intent: Artie must overcome a mechanical handicap.

scenes.outcome: Artie struggles to navigate with his new debuff.
scenes.summary: Artie attempts to walk back to the arena, but the 'Inverted Controls' debuff causes him to hilariously crash into walls and walk backward down the corridor.
scenes.transition_in_text: He takes a confident step toward the door, only to find himself moonwalking into a weapons rack.
scenes.transition_out_text: He finally manages to stumble backward out of the tunnel and into the blinding light of the arena.

scenes.outcome: Artie looks like he's drunk-fighting.
scenes.summary: Artie's debuff is 'Inverted Controls'. Every time he tries to move left, he goes right.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie enters the ring, his legs moving in directions he didn't intend.
scenes.transition_out_text: Fireballs rain down from the Mage's staff as Artie moonwalks.

scenes.outcome: Artie manages to reach the Mage and lands a crit that turns the Mage's staff into a rubber chicken.
scenes.summary: Artie's opponent is a Mage who uses AOE spells. Artie has to 'moonwalk' through the fireballs.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie dodges a blast of flame with an accidental slide.
scenes.transition_out_text: The Mage looks at the squeaking chicken in his hand and sighs.

scenes.outcome: Artie reaches the finals.
scenes.summary: The Mage surrenders out of pure embarrassment.
scenes.transition_in_text: The victory fanfare plays as the Mage walks out of the ring.
scenes.transition_out_text: The Mage looks at the squeaking chicken in his hand and sighs, walking out of the ring.

scenes.outcome: The focus shifts from Artie's victory to Vane's plotting.
scenes.summary: The crowd chants Artie's ridiculous alias as he celebrates his accidental victory, while the perspective shifts to the dark tunnels where his next opponent waits.
scenes.transition_in_text: As the Mage departs, the crowd's chant of 'Crit-iculous!' shakes the arena foundations.
scenes.transition_out_text: Away from the cheering and the sunlight, the perspective shifts to the cold stone of the player tunnel.

scenes.end_condition_echo: Vane watches from the wings, holding a 'System Override' scroll.
scenes.outcome: The final fight will be rigged.
scenes.summary: Vane watches from the wings, holding a 'System Override' scroll he bought from the black market.
scenes.transition_in_text: Vane's cruel laughter echoes in the stone tunnel.

scenes.transition_out_text: Artie stands at the edge of a wireframe cliff, testing his new body.

scenes.outcome: Artie and Fizz navigate the bizarre geometry of the Null-Zone.

scenes.transition_in_text: Artie stands at the edge of a wireframe cliff, testing his new body.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie approaches the steepest part of the cliff, looking down at the jagged polygons below.

scenes.outcome: Artie realizes his immortality is just as annoying as his 1 HP build.

scenes.outcome: Artie is guided safely through the corrupted terrain.
scenes.summary: The Beta-Testers guide Artie through a valley filled with visual artifacts and clipping errors, ensuring they aren't followed by System sub-routines.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie's descent is a blur of unrendered air until he snaps back to the ledge, his boots clicking against the wireframe stone.
scenes.transition_out_text: The figures approach cautiously, their weapons lowered as they emerge from the flickering static of the lower valley.

scenes.outcome: Artie finds allies who know the world's secrets.
scenes.summary: A group of 'Beta-Testers' led by a veteran survivor finds Artie in the Null-Zone.
scenes.transition_in_text: The figures approach cautiously, their weapons lowered as they emerge from the flickering static of the lower valley.
scenes.transition_out_text: The lead tester pulls up a holographic map of the world, the blue light illuminating the grim faces of the camp.

scenes.outcome: The rivalry continues with higher stakes.

scenes.transition_out_text: The group marches through the corrupted foliage, the hum of the portal growing louder with each step.

scenes.transition_in_text: The group marches through the corrupted foliage, the hum of the portal growing louder with each step.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie takes a final look at the wireframe world, his hand hovering over the swirling event horizon.
